title: DGM Experiment Goal — A/B Testing Context
description: Tracks A/B test context for tool invocations. All fields optional; the entire 'experiment' key is omitted for non-experimental calls. Signals carry 1.5x weight in KOTH ELO calculations due to controlled conditions.

template_id.description: Named question/invocation template identifier (e.g., 'arch-decision-v1'). Enables grouping 'same question, different variants' for A/B analysis. Null for ad-hoc calls.

template_version.description: Semver of the template (e.g., '1.2.0'). Bump to test revised option framing, ordering, or presentation. Null for ad-hoc calls.

experiment_id.description: Active A/B experiment this call participates in (e.g., 'exp-markdown-preview-2026-02'). Maps to source_weights.ab_testing in KOTH config (1.5x weight). Null if not in an experiment.

variant_id.description: Which variant within the experiment (e.g., 'markdown-enabled' vs 'text-only'). Used to partition outcomes by treatment group. Null if not in an experiment.

assignment_method.description: How the variant was selected. Optional metadata for reproducibility.

treatment_group.description: Treatment classification: 'control' (baseline) or 'treatment' (experimental). Optional when variant_id is sufficient.
